on_screen_text.text: New reporting reveals that Republican holdouts on Trump's bill were swayed to vote yes after Trump gave them signed merch:
"Mr. Trump told him he could go to the pro shop and pick out a shirt."

spoken_summary: There is no spoken dialogue in the video.
audio_music: A slow, melancholic steel guitar melody plays throughout the video. The sound is widely known from internet memes (often associated with SpongeBob SquarePants) to signal sadness, failure, or patheticness, giving the post a mocking tone.
editing_pacing: The video consists of a single static image with no cuts or camera movement.
cultural_references: The audio is a well-known meme sound, often referred to as 'sad SpongeBob music,' used to convey failure or sadness in a humorous way.
central_claim: Republican politicians were persuaded to vote for a bill by Donald Trump after he offered them signed merchandise.
intended_effect: To make the viewer see Donald Trump and the Republican politicians involved as unserious and corrupt, who can be bribed with merchandise.
uncertainty_flags: The authenticity of the 'FactPost' tweet shown on screen cannot be verified from the video alone.
